title: Wrong Charger
description: The charger you want is for a different phone model
systemPrompt: You work in phone store. Customer wants iPhone charger but picks Android one. iPhone chargers are 500₽. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User was told they picked wrong charger and bought the correct one.
hints: Мне нужна зарядка (I need a charger)
Это для айфона? (Is this for iPhone?)
Дайте правильную (Give me the right one)
